pr_title: fix(rust,python): escape csv header names if they contain special chars
pr_body:
Closes #8315. 

Header names should also be escaped when writing CSV data (eg: if they contain `,` or `"` chars). No new logic, just passes the names through the existing `fmt_and_escape_str`.

## Example

**Setup:**
```python
from io import BytesIO
df = pl.DataFrame( {"c,o,l,u,m,n": [123]} )

buf = BytesIO()
df.write_csv( buf )
```
**Before:**
```python
pl.read_csv( buf )
# shape: (1, 6)
# ┌─────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┐
# │ c   ┆ o    ┆ l    ┆ u    ┆ m    ┆ n    │
# │ --- ┆ ---  ┆ ---  ┆ ---  ┆ ---  ┆ ---  │
# │ i64 ┆ str  ┆ str  ┆ str  ┆ str  ┆ str  │
# ╞═════╪══════╪══════╪══════╪══════╪══════╡
# │ 123 ┆ null ┆ null ┆ null ┆ null ┆ null │
# └─────┴──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┘
```
**After:**
```python
pl.read_csv( buf )
# shape: (1, 1)
# ┌─────────────┐
# │ c,o,l,u,m,n │
# │ ---         │
# │ i64         │
# ╞═════════════╡
# │ 123         │
# └─────────────┘
```

issue_context.title: polars write_csv does not escape column names
issue_context.body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Issue description

Separator characters inside column names of a dataframe do not get escaped when using write_csv.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

a = {'column,1': ['data,1']}
df = pl.DataFrame(a)
print(df.write_csv())
```

This code prints:
```
column,1
"data,1"
```


### Expected behavior

should print:
```
"column,1"
"data,1"
```
